sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Audit osnap/smarttrack queries; xuất service theo snap context và tolerance, không state UI pointer.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.
